RE 32406 Bṛhattālavidhi. This bundle primarily explores the various sections from Śrīmadaghōraśivācāryar’s Kriyākramadyōtikā, particularly focused on ritual related to utsavapūjāvidhi such as bṛhattālam, navasandhi, māsotsavam, pakṣotsavam and ṛkṣotsavam. It also contains an extensive portion of the prāyaścittaviddhi from Kriyākramadyōtikā. Towards the end, themanuscript presents some incomplete sections pertaining to the śivaliṅgapañcāsanapūjā. (i. 42a) praṇyaṅga dhūpadānena pañcamasya śataṃ japet|| dīpānomathavaikalye japedghora śatatrayam| dīpāni dviguṇaṃ paścāddevadevaṃ pradāpayet|| (2) rakṣādīpasya vicchede pyevaṃ dviguṇa jāpayuk| haviṣyadatte devāya snapanaṃ tu vidhāya ca|| dviguṇaṃ dāpyetpaścādāmantrana haviṣyati| (3) athakāndhapaṭe hīne kavacaṃ dviśataṃ japet|| śrī medhā dakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥ|| prati saṃvatsarāmāsaṃ nidhiyuktaṃ tu tīrthakam| (4) niścityavartate pūrvamutsavoyairdinaiḥ purā| navāhādyaiyuto bherī tāḍanādi purassaram||(5) taddinātriguṇe vahni taddinadviguṇe'pivā| tadanyathātu kṛto daivīkevārṣake'pivā|| (2) māsabhaṃ tīrthanakṣatramanyathā vā nayedvijāḥ| utsavoyairdinaiḥ pūrvaistasya vṛddhiphalapradā|| rāṣṭrakṣobhe ca durbhikṣe rājācorabhayādiṣu| (3) vittābhāvenya bhītibhyaḥ dhvajārohe vihīnetu nṛpaterbhayamādiśet| śāntiṃ kṛtvā tadāmantri punarāropayedhvajam|| (3) dhvajasya bhramaṇe hīne grāmādāvaśubhāvaham| śāntihomaṃ tadākuryāt sarvadoṣanivṛttaye|| vedī vihīnā vā lakṣaṇā vā śubhapradā| (4) śāntihomaṃ tadākṛtvā vedīṃ kuryāt salakṣaṇam|| daṇḍolakṣaṇahīnaṃ ca prādhanasya śubhāvaham| mūrtihomaṃ tadākuryāt śāntihomaṃ tathāpivā|| (5)
